en: (not really mad, teasing playfully) Didn't Uncle Chen tell you to look after me? And you just ditched me and ran off.
You may have called me "sister," but I'm not one to go easy on sweet-talking little boys.
...Sounds a bit over the top, but seems to line up.
**Sighs**
Not with the stitches we normally use. We mostly do flowers, birds, and characters from plays and stories.
My wish has been on that plaque all along: may every question be familiar, and every answer right!
Quiet... keep your voice down. Those Qiongqi Artificers over there will hear us.
That was an incredible performance. I have nothing but admiration for it!
...I wasn't sulky.
Whoa, already blushing?
In that case, think about it. If Uncle Chen lived as rigidly as you do, would he still be himself?
Maybe they're not interesting enough.
Right, right.
Yes. Uncle An, this is the Junior Brother Master escorted here. Junior Brother, meet Uncle An. If you have any questions about the house, you can come to him.
Come back to the Sea of Brushes when you have time. I'll save one for you!
The name's Li Baisi! Bai, as in ferrying passengers across the water. Si, as in wandering the four corners of the world! Now, I'd already hung up my oars for the day...
Look! The path ahead just connected on its own!
If you were the Dao Lord, and needed someone to buy a large batch of grain, who would you send?
Why are you looking at me like that?
Let's see... Black hair, about three cun long, rather coarse. It smells faintly of sandalwood... and blood.
No, thanks. I'll go take a look over there.
I'm going.
T-Thank you for fixing it.
Do you long to fly beyond those walls too?
Pft. Since you're so good-hearted, why don't you just lead the way?
Look at the thread in my hand. We use thick, double-stranded yarn for clothing. If you stitched a large patch of it, it would just look like a flat, stiff blotch of white. It simply wouldn't work.
Oh my, that did the trick! My mind's clear as day now!
More wine? Didn't you have enough back in the tomb? Forget it, don't let me interrupt.
Are Fang Bai and the Golden Peach both at the bottom of the lake?
I won't make things hard for our new disciple. Since you've passed initiation, just use the Everlink Form and meet me up here.
Huh? It went back down.
Crownleek Terrace has been a decent, peaceful place for twenty years! How did we breed such a treacherous scoundrel? I say we report him to the magistrate!
Zzzz...
Do you know which house each quilt belongs to?
He promised. When the grain ripened, he'd come back and teach us to build wooden kites... He wouldn't just forget, right?
The young one said so. What more do you need?
If you ever come through Xiangzhou, look us up. There'll always be a meal for you.
If you don't mind an old man's advice, many spend their youth roaming and end up deciding home was best all along.
Everything depends on you now.

Her qi and blood fell out of balance twelve days ago. The red marks itch and cause some pain, though nothing severe. And there's something in the lung meridian... No, her lungs are fine. It's a blocked nose.
Master, why did you sit down? Are you using your inner power to force all the smoke outside?
Once we're back, I'll have Lei get every village in the area to fix up their kilns. Heh heh...
What do you want?
Lady Zhao, I fought my way here. I am not one to be underestimated. If you have a plan, speak it to me now!
Ah, I see. Best to be discreet. So, shall we begin the investigation?
Big Zhao, do you think he really knows?
Now that I've got the grain, I need to sell it to... the Dao Lord...
Yes, yes, I have it!
Because you want to know the general's secret, and I want to know Jiang Yan's past...
I may be slow, but my father taught me one thing: trust only those who deserve it. Everything you say is flawless, Master Jin. That is exactly why I do not trust you.
You mean... kindred spirits, junior brother?
Wake up! Please wake up!
Pleased to meet you, Uncle An! But wait, you've heard of me?
I don't think the Grandmaster would do such a thing…
You're the beauty, I'm the hero. Isn't this exactly a hero-saves-beauty story?
Everything depends on you now.
How did you manage to get these feathers? Teach me!
And looking at all these parts scattered here, your sect must use this place to build things, right?
You... Let me try.
...Hereby welcome you inside the sect manor.
Whose little boy is this? What a thoughtful child.
So you're traveling with us to get into the mountains, too?
Big Feng, all Mohist Sect disciples know how to build those wooden birds, right?
Who's there?!
...I... (hesitating, Chen Shen takes a step forward out of the pavilion, where he spots Cui Tianming nearby)
I didn't lie. With the elders at each other's throats over opening or sealing the mountain, seeking them out will only bring trouble. I'd rather focus on my paper.
Didn't you say we had to fly across? Let's just give it a shot.
Well, a little humility goes a long way, don't you think?
Which would you prefer?
Big Zhao, the Ember of East is no joke. You don't plan on slipping in right under his nose, do you?
But I've certainly never seen one, and my mother never taught it to me.
I'm a victim here too, you know!
A wanderer inside the most heavily guarded palace in the land, and you call yourself innocent? You asked for the Sealed Treasury by name. How did you even know it existed?
If you keep dwelling on the past, you won't be able to even savor this meal we're eating right now! Well, young lady, should we come across a fine dish someday, we'll find a way to inform you.
She's incredibly gifted. I can hear it.
My apologies, Sister, I'm truly swamped at the moment. Please rest here for a bit. I'll be right back once I find Master.
You! ...Everyone knows Kaifeng is short on copper coins. Don't you?
If I were him, the only thing I'd have to decide is whether to laze around at home or somewhere else... Oh, I wish I had his life!
Who's there?!
This place always fills up before the exams. People come for a good omen and to calm their nerves.
No! Not this again!
I'm hoping they do. If someone wants to keep her ill, the medicine will force them to show their hand.
Another one of those cockroach thieves... oh wait, a new face? Sun! Get someone to show her around!
And our new paragon here found Sky Shudelle!
If there's one thing I'm good at, it's pushing. I bounced between more schools than I can count, all to learn the craft of Powder-propelled Arrow.
Huh?
Look! We... we found it! It's the Hero Whistle!
The real Kaifeng?
Alright, alright... I believe you. I can rest easy. Huang Chuan's not rebelling. That's all I needed to hear.
Come on…!
(exasperated) Why did you bring this one in?
Are you here to borrow something? I'm tied up at the moment. Please ask one of the other students for help.
Might as well carry him back inside.
No, no! The Mouth Admonition warns that misfortune comes from loose lips. I have failed the teachings of the sages and spoken carelessly.
It's me, it's me. A familiar face, heh. Did I come at a bad time?
Something you need?
Not even in the city yet, and I'm already running into all kinds of swindlers...
Now that I've got the grain, I need to sell it to... the Dao Lord...
Did you see that fog? The Master Scholar says it's the celestial mist of the Haven drifting this way.
Yes, but the principle is far grander.
Hold on! That's "Heavenly Silks", composed by the master of Revelry Hall herself! How can you just hand it over to her?
The lift has stopped! No, it's someone jamming it!
(indifferent) Oh. (on purpose) Nope, I definitely will do it again.
What can I do for you, young man?
You see, I've been staying up late. My mind's a bit foggy...
Yes! The immortals of the Haven are amazing! They can fly in the sky and know all kinds of arts... My brother's studying with them right now!
Forgive the lack of a proper welcome!
It's rarely a good sign. Someone must be fanning the flames, trying to draw it out into the open.
Where did you find something like this?
He's afraid Zhu Youli might fail. The moment Fang Bai enters the city, he'll blow the whole thing up rather than let anyone else get the Golden Peach.
So you're traveling with us to get into the mountains, too?
Some take sincerity for foolishness, but they are wrong. What matters the most is a clear conscience.
Well, another hurdle crossed. I can feel the white hairs sprouting already.
Help me...

She's in pain as well as itching, and her nose is a little blocked... I've cleared her meridians, so she should start feeling better soon. But until we find out what's causing that handprint, we're only treating the symptoms.
Big Feng? Big Feng?
Senior Brother Meng, watch out! Senior Brother Meng, are you alright?
Explosions from the shore, one after another. It's Zhu Wen!
And looking at all these parts scattered here, your sect must use this place to build things, right?
It's you?!
Help me...
A moment later, and I'd have beaten them all.
Excellent! I'll make a brush with it tonight!
We won't impose any longer if you say so. A new term is about to begin at Pinglan Academy, and we will be enrolling too. If the Young Lady has any more troubles, just send someone to us.
All right, I'll tell you the truth. They're my lecture notes from Master's classes. He always tells us to pass on the old teachings faithfully, not claim them as our own.
Me? Pay the bill?
Sir—
Maybe they're not interesting enough.
After all, spring nights are short and wait for no one~
Swallow, you...
I hadn't noticed that before.
Alright, here's the plan—not only am I not going to pay you, I'm going to borrow some coins from you too.
That night, I was crouching beneath his window eavesdropping, and I heard him muttering to himself about killing people to seize the official seal...
Yeah, stories are meant to be shared, right?
I-I missed the rope... Brother, are you okay?!
Exactly! Even he gets it, Stork, why can't you?!
What? I'm supposed to take him out?
So the moment I opened my mouth, I gave myself away.
Funny how the world works. You're the man who killed my father... and the man who saved me.
She said it's her treat! I don't have a single coin on me!
Yes. Look up, we've arrived.
My apologies. Allow me a word with my junior brother.
Ahem! The Grandmaster leads Mohist Hill, but someone like her is elusive. Her whereabouts are not for us to know. You'd be better off asking her disciples.
Benefactor, thank you. My name is Zhang Ci. In eighteen years, let us meet again in the jianghu.
(concerned) ...Leapt off the pagoda?
If the chest is valuable enough, we have every reason to ask the one guarding the mountain for passage.
The wine came a little late, but it's strong. Haha, share a cup like this, and we're friends in life or death.
Greetings, Miss. I am Chen Shen from the Vernal Hall. We received an invitation from the Gu family today, and I've come in my master's stead. This here is my junior brother.
Alright then. I'm betting this music score. If you win, it's yours. No questions asked.
Oh! Forgive me. I didn't realize you were asking. I'm making a wish to Confucius.
Is that…?
Why not?
Pleased to meet you, Uncle An! But wait, you've heard of me?
Hahahaha! Come on, kid. You give it a try!
Do you really have a lead?
I'm so glad you found it, miss. Everyone put so much care into making it for us. I'd have felt awful if it were lost because of me, and Master Meng would've been terribly disappointed.
I should be roaming the jianghu, a jug of coarse wine in hand.
The study! If he hid anything, it'd be in here!
Junior Sister, would you mind telling me what your paper is about?
Come on…!
We were worried about him. Ever since he failed the Inkbound Order exam, he's been cooped up in his room, hardly saying a word. We were afraid he'd do something foolish...
This is the Sky Shudelle! Come over here!
Mm.
Infiltrated the Imperial Service. Asked me for directions to the Sealed Treasury.
You opened my eyes to an entirely new material. I'd never considered a crow's tail feathers!
Divine Might Fang Xu is here too?
Really? I never read a book in my life, never been past the village gate. You swear you're not fooling me?
And that wasn't even the worst of it! Then he started muttering about taking lives and claiming what belongs to the ones up top!
I've got your back, Zhou! If Fang Bai gets you, I'll break you out myself!
So that's the story behind Sunken City Lake! Someone blew up Peach Grove Pass and flooded the whole city.
I just wanted to actually make one. I forced myself to learn archery, calculations, mechanics...
If she won't go, I must trouble Miss Qiao'er to make the trip instead. Bring the prescription to the Vernal Hall. They'll brew the medicine and send it over.
Truth and falsehood are a matter of the heart. Master Peng may never find a disciple, but that doesn't mean I won't accept one.
Oh please, Guildmaster Bai isn't around. This young wanderer looks sharp enough to me. Why not give him a listen?
Wait! You said an Elder was supposed to meet you here and bring you back. And that Elder still hasn't shown up?
That's not what I meant.
Hey, easy now! Watch your step—
This is important! It's due today! You can do it!
Can we speak outside for a moment?
That night, I was crouching beneath his window eavesdropping, and I heard him muttering to himself about killing people to seize the official seal...
Everyone, stop! Let's talk this through!
Truth and falsehood are a matter of the heart. Master Peng may never find a disciple, but that doesn't mean I won't accept one.
Besides, I know exactly what goes through every newcomer's head.
Ha! You're hilarious. Lose once, and you will be my personal wine server for a month.
Big Zhao, so this is the renowned Know-it-all of Kaifeng, as brilliant as Zhuge Liang...
I have nothing to repay you with... But I noticed you've been searching for the Haven too? You're in the right place.
It may seem coarse, but it's filled with genuine feeling from start to finish. Reading this letter, I finally understood that even a mere page could hold deep, boundless love.
Thanks!
Ahem! The Grandmaster leads Mohist Hill, but someone like her is elusive. Her whereabouts are not for us to know. You'd be better off asking her disciples.
W-what are you doing here?
So, who do you want to tell these stories to?
It's grown late and we've been nothing but a bother to you. I'm sorry for all this fuss, young one.
Impressive! You hung it so high I can barely see it without breaking my neck!
It happens to be lotus pod season. You're in for a treat!
Ahem! The Grandmaster leads Mohist Hill, but someone like her is elusive. Her whereabouts are not for us to know. You'd be better off asking her disciples.
People say I'm fickle. They're not wrong.
Thank you, Grandpa! And you, mister!
You're changing, too?
We meet again, Junior! Perfect timing! You caught me just as I was leaving.
Old Jin, where's this buyer?
Good. If you have any questions, come find me at the Grace Pavilion.
Aunt Han, things here are far more complicated than I thought.
Maybe I'll return, maybe I won't. I'm going wherever the road takes me.
I tracked you all the way to Qinghe, only to hear that you were already dead.
Might as well carry him back inside.
Crow tail feathers. Smooth and glossy, longer than chicken feathers, broader than duck feathers, and denser than goose feathers...
Well...
Be careful...
I'm, I'm f-fine. Totally fine.
I saw it myself! One of the older girls picked up a whole stack of books and leaped straight onto the roof. No wonder they've managed to spread books all the way up there!
Your zeal for the odd and curious doesn't seem most fitting for a noble either, no?
Wait, how did a Senior Brother Tian squeeze in between those three? I would've missed him if I hadn't looked closely.
If this coal refining business works out, I might just become village head!
Without studying the ancient texts, and with no master for guidance...
If you were the Dao Lord, and needed someone to buy a large batch of grain, who would you send?
Wait. Miss, unless I'm mistaken, these two letters were not written by the same person, yes?
An interesting question indeed. Unfortunately, long bound by the reins of prestige and gain, it's been a while since I truly stopped and appreciated a dish's flavors.
(indifferent) Oh. (on purpose) Nope, I definitely will do it again.
Come on, Big Feng! I believe in you!
The young one said so. What more do you need?
It's grown late and we've been nothing but a bother to you. I'm sorry for all this fuss, young one.
Old Liu, what do you know? You think a rebel's going to hear us out? He might take a blade to you!
...Someone actually showed. Take it and go.
Now that you know, please keep this to yourself! If word gets out, Meng will be in trouble...
Conjure up the cash yourself, and you can curse me out all day!
The wine is... Why is it so strong...?
I didn't mean to wreck the vats. I really didn't.
She always curls the wing tips. Says that way Master Raven can spot it instantly. She's a clever one. Always has been...
He's a natural. I can tell just by listening.
Is that…?
I followed Uncle Chen's lead in all this mischief.
I always stick to the same vendors for the meat and greens. Now, I may look careless, but I always do background checks before buying from a stall.
Should I unleash the stink attack?
Cut the chatter.
Wait... I have a rather strange request. That second letter... might I have it as a keepsake? After all, I did provide a critique like you asked.
You may have no manners, Mr. Gu, but I was taught better. Still, since you've bowed so deeply in apology to my master, I'll let this go. I trust you won't behave like that again.
Fight me, lass! If you win, no one here will stand in your way. Deal?
No, no! The Mouth Admonition warns that misfortune comes from loose lips. I have failed the teachings of the sages and spoken carelessly.
The wine is... Why is it so strong...?
Master Raven hasn't come back in so long...
Miss, my junior sister is a skilled doctor as well. I'd feel more confident with her helping me.
...Very well. Can you give us some more details about the Young Lady's symptoms?
Come on, Big Feng! I believe in you!
If the Haven truly exists, it wasn't built in a day. There was no word of it on the jianghu because it was deliberately kept secret.
That's right. I came to see the owner of this house. You're his... daughter? Sister?
There's a hidden drawer?
Shouldn't a girl like you be home with her needlework?
Look! We... we found it! It's the Hero Whistle!
Cough... Qingdai has the right of it. If you have something to cover your face, do put it on and join us.
Helping with the quilts, little one?
Listen here, you. Next time you visit, I might not just be an old scholar anymore.
With the agency gone, the three of us won't be able to guard this chest for long. The longer we linger, the greater the risk. We should leave now and make our plans when we reach the mountain.
You made such a big bet without even knowing about Sister Ruolan's capabilities...
Keen eyes, young man! Aye, I'm just a humble boatman on West Lake. Since you've caught me out, no sense in hiding it.
I heard some artists in Kaifeng were lucky enough to see you in person.
We've come this far together. I promised to take you into the mountain, and I won't quit on the last stretch.
Well, there is indeed a plan, though not the most reliable one.
Sir—
Go ahead. The master will post up a notice about this, and everyone in the sect will know there's a new Emissary in the Vernal Hall called Da Huang.
Come back to the Sea of Brushes when you have time. I'll save one for you!
We've set aside a room for you especially. It should be fully ready now.
Big Zhao, the Ember of East is no joke. You don't plan on slipping in right under his nose, do you?
Is there any way to find out who this mask belongs to?
...Hmm?
He promised. When the grain ripened, he'd come back and teach us to build wooden kites... He wouldn't just forget, right?
You totally ditched me. You'd better figure out how to explain yourself to Uncle Chen once we're home!
Ah, yes... Of course. This way, then, Doctor Chen. You too... Da Huang.
Looks like I'm right.
Oh... no, no, no. Folks around Crownleek Terrace are just honest farmers. Who'd be talking about rebellion?
Greetings, Madam.
So it's true...
(turns around) So you admit that you ditched me, huh? Well, tell me. Why'd you suddenly get all sulky just now?
Another child clinging to the past. Very well. I'll tell him the truth next time.
The young one said so. What more do you need?
The wine came a little late, but it's strong. Haha, share a cup like this, and we're friends in life or death.
Interesting.
Yes and no.
Right, right.
He's afraid Zhu Youli might fail. The moment Fang Bai enters the city, he'll blow the whole thing up rather than let anyone else get the Golden Peach.
No, no! Years of study can't be reduced to a ranking. People come here hoping to do justice to all they've learned... and for a little good fortune!
Uh, well, Mr. Cui... my family wants me home for dinner. I must take my leave!
I did hear that Elder Peng invited a guest...
Master Jin. Eloquent. Every piece fits perfectly.
Every Mohist has their own way of interfacing with mechanisms. I remember once, after being deeply moved by fragments of the ancient Everlink Form scripture, I went to ask Master Peng for her wisdom.
Wandering the jianghu... well, to each their own.
Just doing my duty.
But caged birds... they're meant to stay caged for life.
My apologies. He's...
You win the fight, you make the rules.
Sir, are you a student here too? Besides reading and writing, do they teach you how to fly?
Thanks!
What do you mean?
No way we'd try anything new with the poor Young Lady so ill. We just make the same few dishes over and over.
How peculiar. Since when did I start talking like that?
Did she leave...? She left a piece of peach blossom hairpin behind?
My apologies. My junior is still young and rebellious.
Stay vigilant.
Divine Might Fang Xu is here too?

Master Meng says the Inkbound Order pays for our school so children from poor families can learn to read and write. That way, we can keep studying when we're older and learn how to tell right from wrong.
Fine, fine. I'll change.
Oh right, the wanderer's got your back too!
...Someone actually showed. Take it and go.
Disturb the Mansion Master and I'll throw you out the window.
Master Meng, this is the kind lady who found my book!
Big Zhao, you're trading in too?
Enough with the teasing. Staying any longer is asking for trouble. Let's get out of here.
The young one said so. What more do you need?
You're a perceptive child.
Hahaha! That's right!
Oh! Looks like Sister Bai Rong snatched that #Npeony hairpin#E!
What makes you say that?
If you care for others, they'll stand with you. Even Master Raven said so. And I don't think you're a bad person.
He's the recipient, and we're with him. It's true. If you don't believe me, ask...
Finally, a new recruit! The lieutenant will be thrilled... any longer and we'd be worked to the bone. Literally.
Does that mean they're trapped in the cage forever?
Junior.
Uh, well, Mr. Cui... my family wants me home for dinner. I must take my leave!
Not bad, lad. Go ahead. No one's going to stop you now.
Be careful...
They are clean.
Well, if she let you through...
...Asleep again.
What do you suspect?
A natural? Miss Ling, what's gotten into you?
That's right. I study under Master Meng at the Wellspring Primary Academy.
Alright.
I've been trapped here half my life. You're the second person to find your way in.
Someday, when we've both found our place in the world, let's come back and see whether this plaque is still hanging here.
Go have a look at what lies beyond the cliff. Feng, stay. I have something to ask you.

It's a long story. I was chasing a petty thief, stumbled into his contact, got mistaken for their hired hand, and next thing I know I'm inside the palace. The name came from the man who brought me in. Why, is it a problem?
Very well! Thank you, Senior Brother and Uncle An! And Uncle Chen too.
If I let you go that easily, wouldn't that make me a fool?
Me?
I snuck over there again just now! Huang Chuan was muttering about "beheading the folk" in the dark! Scared the life right out of me!
What do you suspect?
If this coal refining business works out, I might just become village head!
This way, please, Doctor Chen.
(fleeing in embarrassment) ...Thank you for the guidance, Sir. My junior sister and I have urgent matters to attend to, so we'll take our leave.
And the talent! Chess, music, calligraphy, martial arts, there's nothing you can't master at first glance. A true prodigy!
It's leaps and bounds.
Wrong. I'm the one playing with you.
Ahem...
Senior Brother... do you actually want what's good for Uncle Chen or not?
I saw it myself! One of the older girls picked up a whole stack of books and leaped straight onto the roof. No wonder they've managed to spread books all the way up there!
So... what's our hero's plan next?
You opened my eyes to an entirely new material. I'd never considered a crow's tail feathers!
Ouch! You...
That's probably for the best! Confucius has plenty to keep him busy, but when he looks down, yours will be the first plaque he sees.
Junior Brother, why did you follow me here?
You play a woman better than I thought. At least you didn't mess up my plan.
But if you're serious about calling off the marriage, I might have a plan.
I didn't lie. With the elders at each other's throats over opening or sealing the mountain, seeking them out will only bring trouble. I'd rather focus on my paper.
You know each other?
Hm, that gave me an idea. Junior Brother, you'll be Da Huang from now on.
*chuckles*
I just wanted to actually make one. I forced myself to learn archery, calculations, mechanics...
Don't let her escape!
I only asked her a couple of questions.
You all sound so righteous, shouting to open the mountain. But what will we do when the money runs out?
Master Jin. A blade that wounds… has no fault. The fault lies… with whoever wields it.
But if you object so strongly to how I do things, take this prescription back to the Vernal Hall for me. Once you've delivered it, you can run along and play.
You're so good at fishing! Can you teach me? I want to catch lots for Miao!
I heard that part too! Forging blades, raising horses, and going off to war!
My lady, it's our masks!
Junior Sister, why did you follow me here?
Young Master! Perfect timing. I just brewed some tea. Have a cup.
An interesting question indeed. Unfortunately, long bound by the reins of prestige and gain, it's been a while since I truly stopped and appreciated a dish's flavors.
My junior will deliver the prescription to the Vernal Hall and—
Clinging? Ha! Foolish boy...

There are plenty of camphor trees in Hangzhou, which is why the Young Lady has had a stuffy nose of late. And then someone brought fresh camphor wood into her living quarters, greatly worsening her condition.
Can you tell me where the closest outhouse is? My friend went to use the bathroom but hasn't returned.
Useful?
Uncle Li will do. I handle the grocery shopping and cooking.
Hahaha...
In that case, think about it. If Uncle Chen lived as rigidly as you do, would he still be himself?
(on guard, a little guilty) What are you going to tattle about?
If I can make you think I'm Jiang Yan, I can make a madman think that too.
I'm so sorry! Making you chase a mouse for me... I've wasted your time...
Is he... Uncle Jiang's enemy? But he's been missing for a long time... Perhaps I can learn something from this man.
I waited half a year for this chance...
Yeah, stories are meant to be shared, right?
It was I who conceived the Everlink Form years ago, through my own understanding of "the unbreakable link." I have never passed it on to anyone. Not even Master Peng.
Infiltrated the Imperial Service. Asked me for directions to the Sealed Treasury.
Just don't wander off too far!
And you know, you could just call me your junior sister.
Wonderful. Pick a spot and hang your plaque. Are you wishing good fortune for someone else, or asking for some yourself?
A true hero has big dreams, which means traveling around and cleaning up the jianghu.
The hard part, huh? I'll have to think about that...
Where did you find something like this?
Are you here to borrow something? I'm tied up at the moment. Please ask one of the other students for help.
Something you need?
Yes, but the principle is far grander.
He's the sect's newest Emissary... Da Huang.
Maybe… this has something to do with him?
How thoughtful of you, Emissary. I'll gladly take the credit for catching our mountain demon. Thank you for doing all the running around, Junior Brother.
A new face? Where are you from?
The Grandmaster has ignored people like us for a long time.
Keep quiet all you want. I bet the officials are eager to hear what you know.
What do you want?
So... why have you brought me these two letters?
Do you really have a lead?
My junior will deliver the prescription to the Vernal Hall and—
So the rest of us are doing double shifts. I fought in actual wars and never worked this hard.
What a fine spot! I'd better start clearing the ground so the others can join us.
The Grandmaster has refused visitors since taking office. Only those with true talent can catch her attention. You might as well give up now.
Explosions from the shore, one after another. It's Zhu Wen!
Heh, our young master's got a nose for lost things. Knows every nook and cranny here by heart!
Junior Sister, did you manage to catch—
I-I'm innocent...
